full_judgment: 7. Mr. Syed Khalequzzaman, the learned Advocate appearing for the plaintiff-petitioner in the course of argument after placing the relevant materials on record including the impugned judgment as well as the judgment of the trial Court below submits that the Court of appeal below under misconception of law and facts most illegally without adverting the material findings of the trial Court passed the impugned judgment which is, in fact, not a proper judgment of reversal. He next submits that the pre-emptor in order to prove its case examined 3(three) PWs including himself as PW-1 and all the PWs categorically stated that the pre-emptor-petitioner just after knowing about the impugned transfer claimed the suit land in performing Taleb-i-mowasibat on 01.7.87 and Talab-i-ishat on 7.7.87 but the Court of appeal below abruptly without applying its judicial mind to the materials on record arrived at a finding that the plaintiff could not or did not perform Taleb-i-ishat as per provisions of Mohammedan Law which caused failure of justice.
